properties.decision:
RECORDED AS BRAINSTORMING, NOT AS A PROPOSAL. Anthony, 2026-09-13, following the units brainstorm.

HIS FRAMING, in his words: reflow2's opening statement was "design anything", and the natural domain is obviously coding projects — designing a house or a new weather satellite is not. What if every design first started with a "pseudocode" design, or a "pseudo-design": the scaffolding/concept of a design, what other domains call a mockup? Review https://github.com/paralleldrive/sudolang for ideas. He is driving at a formal LAYER in the graph that captures the pseudo-design. Far-out extreme: if there is no language an AI agent can understand for this, invent a "pseudo-design" / "pseudo-systems-engineering" language. His own counter: reflow2 may already build some pseudo-design concept natively into the graph.

WHAT SUDOLANG IS (read 2026-09-13): a pseudocode language for collaborating with language models — interfaces (typed structures), natural-language constraints "continuously respected by the AI", functions and a pipe operator, /commands as the chat surface, semantic pattern matching. Its load-bearing claim: "All sufficiently advanced language models understand it without any special prompting. You do not need to paste the SudoLang specification." It is domain-independent because it is declarative and constraint-based rather than syntax-bound. Its constructs map onto reflow2's vocabulary almost one to one: interface → Interface/Component, constraint → Constraint/DesignRule, requirement → Requirement, function → Capability (with a signature), /command → a served skill. What SudoLang has that reflow2 does not: a human can WRITE and READ the whole program on one page.

═══ THE COUNTER HE RAISED IS LARGELY RIGHT, AND HERE IS THE MEASUREMENT ═══
reflow2 already holds a pseudo-design layer. It is distributed and unnamed:
· GENESIS STOPS AT FUNCTION. The greenfield skill seeds requirements (P0) and capabilities (P1) and says "Do NOT create Components (P2) yet — leaving structure unspecified is deliberate"; the `concept_without_design` detector fires at zero Components and is the question "how should this be structured?", answered with the user. That IS a concept phase, enforced.
· THE MATURITY TRAJECTORY is the ladder from concept to implementable: intent → function → allocation → seams → realization → assurance → operation, "function first, structure later", with the frontier named and no verdict on where a design SHOULD sit ("a demonstrator may sit at 40% forever and be right").
· EVERY NODE IS BORN PLANNED. Component, Capability, Artifact and Release all land at `planned`; Requirement at `proposed`; Decision at `proposed`; an Interface's medium at `unspecified`. A design made only of planned things IS a mockup.
· THE BLACK BOX WITHOUT ITS INSIDE. req:recursive-black-box-decomposition: every element is a black box with inner function and interfaces; a capability signature (inputs/outputs) describes function without mechanism — the pseudocode of a capability. Capability.delivery = `model` lets model work be reported delivered — the mockup as a deliverable.
· THE BUILD TIER ALREADY HAS `pseudocode`: Fragment.fragment_type includes it, phase P0–P5, note_kind author = "the implementer's intent/pseudocode".
· IDEAS BEFORE INTENT: exploratory Decisions (87 on this graph) are thought recorded as thought.
· TEXT IN, DESIGN OUT already exists: ingest_step extracts a design from freeform text with the agent as the model (verified), and corpus ingest does it for a folder.

AND THE MEASUREMENT OF HOW MUCH OF THAT LAYER IS ACTUALLY REACHED, on reflow2's own graph 2026-09-13: capability signatures set on 3 of 247; delivery=model on 2; Fragment pseudocode on 0 of 268 (257 are `implementation`); artifact types used: code 225, document 74, spec 11, test 30, config 2 — and model, drawing, diagram, asset, binary, data, test_result: ZERO; Project.domain = "software", written by genesis and read by nothing; 5 of 22 interfaces still at medium unspecified. Sideways finding worth its own look: 106 of 108 Components read `planned` on a shipped system — the status was never moved, so "born planned" is also "never promoted".

So the honest statement: THE VOCABULARY FOR A PSEUDO-DESIGN EXISTS AND THE PROCESS ENFORCES ITS ORDER; WHAT DOES NOT EXIST IS (1) A NAME FOR THE LAYER AND A WAY TO SEE IT AS ONE THING, (2) THE FUNCTION HALF POPULATED (signatures), (3) A COMPACT TEXT FORM A PERSON CAN WRITE AND READ, and (4) NON-SOFTWARE WORKED PATHS — the same gap dec:idea-reflow2-serves-a-project-that-is-not-software records (neutral nouns, software-shaped examples, and the Environment/EnvironmentRule compliance layer "that makes design a house concrete" designed and never built).

═══ OPTIONS, none chosen ═══
(A) NAME THE LAYER AND RENDER IT. "Pseudo-design" = the design with nothing realized: requirements, capabilities with signatures, constraints with units, boundaries named even if unspecified, no components required. One computed view reads it back as a whole — the concept on one page — under the standing doctrine that reflow2 serves content and the agent renders (the same division the SV-1/SV-4 increment uses). CHEAP: a projection over what exists. COUNTER: another view nobody reads is the vocabulary-nothing-reaches disease; it earns its place only if genesis and where-am-i hand it to the user unasked.

(B) A COMPACT TEXT FORM, ROUND-TRIPPABLE — the SudoLang idea applied honestly. Render the pseudo-design as structured natural language (shall-statements, capability signatures as function headers, black boxes with ports, constraints with units, rules as constraints "continuously respected") that a person can edit; ingest reads the same form back. Half of this exists (ingest_step, graph_report_markdown, export_surface). SudoLang's real lesson is that the agent needs NO new language — structured English with constraints is already understood — so the design of the form is a rendering convention, not a grammar. COUNTER: a second serialization drifts from the schema; views must be pure projections and any renderer fill-in is a defect (his UAF doctrine); and "invent our own pseudo-SE language" is the over-engineering he watches for — the schema IS the language, and describe_schema already serves it to the agent.

(C) POPULATE THE FUNCTION HALF — make the capability signature the pseudocode of the design. The setter exists; the instruction leg and the absence-noticing leg do not (3 of 247). Genesis and capture-intent ask "what does it take in, what does it give out?" for every capability, and the concept view reports the fraction signed. CHEAP, and it is the half of "pseudo-design" that has content rather than status. COUNTER: the three-legs rule was already stated for this exact field and only one leg was built, deliberately, to avoid 170 findings overnight — so the detector must be aggregate.

(D) DECLARE THE PHASE, OR DERIVE IT. A design at concept stage says so (declared) or is read as such from zero Components (derived) so detectors stop reporting a mockup's islands as defects — dec:idea-a-detector-can-read-the-phase-the-design-already-declares, already open. COUNTER recorded there: a declared marker nothing reads is the disease; a consumer design measured ZERO Epoch nodes after months, so phase-by-epoch is dead on arrival.

(E) A CONCEPT-COMPLETE CHECK — the SRR/SDR made computable: every requirement has a capability, every capability a signature, every external boundary named, every quantity a unit; reported as readiness to structure, never as a gate. COUNTER: QualityGate was retired because the phase gate dissolved into the detectors; this would re-invent it unless it is a report, not a stop.

(F) THE PHYSICAL-DOMAIN HALF — mockup as drawings and models: Artifact types model/drawing/diagram exist and are used ZERO times; the Environment/EnvironmentRule layer (codes, site, physics) is designed and unbuilt; one worked non-software example end to end (Alex's shop, a house) is the cheapest evidence. COUNTER: it is the delivery gap already open under Alex's name, and it is a different problem from the layer question — solving one is not solving the other.

(G) NOTHING. The order is enforced, the vocabulary is neutral, the agent adapts. COUNTER: the second user concluded the opposite from what he saw, and the owner has now asked the same question from the other side.

⭐ THE READING (a finding, not a decision): the counter is right that the LAYER exists; it is wrong that it is VISIBLE. C and A together are the cheap, honest move — give the pseudo-design content (signatures) and a single readable projection — and they make B mostly unnecessary because a rendered concept page in structured English IS the SudoLang form, produced by the agent from the graph rather than parsed into it. F is real but is Alex's open thread, not this one. Inventing a language is the road not to take: SudoLang's own claim is that the language already exists.
properties.name: SETTLED — promoted into: Every capability is asked what it takes in and gives out at capture, and the fraction left unsigned is reported in aggregate — the function half of the pseudo-design… (and 1 more)
properties.rationale: Anthony's brainstorm, following the units question. Recorded because his own counter ("reflow2 may already build this natively") turned out to be measurable and largely true, and the measurement — which pieces of the concept-stage vocabulary are reached on reflow2's own graph — is the part that would be lost if only the conversation held it. The SudoLang comparison is recorded so the "invent our own language" option carries its strongest counter-argument in the language's own words.
